summary: The first part of a series on privacy enhancement for Internet electronic mail, defining message encipherment and authentication procedures. It is meant to work with many key management approaches, both symmetric and public-key. It came out of IAB Privacy Task Force meetings, was a proposal, and was replaced by RFC 1040 and RFC 1113.

eli5.summary: It explains how to put your email in a locked box and sign it, so only the right person can open it and they know it truly came from you.

questions: how to encrypt and authenticate internet email
